verdict.rationale: Embedding a framework into an existing server-rendered page is a fair question for a UI framework, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing on mounting Angular components into existing HTML pages, such as custom elements or partial page bootstrapping. The related items do not qualify: Angular Universal SSR (angular-comm-5) prerenders a whole SPA, and the jQlite note (angular-comm-9) concerns legacy AngularJS interoperating with jQuery, not embedding components in a page.
